subject: Coordinating invoice creation & portal onboarding for Pollen Health - VAT ID and evidence
messages:
From: Samir Khanna <samir.khanna@pollenhealth.com>
To: Rachel Kim <rachel_kim@redwoodinference.com>
Cc: Pollen Health AP <ap@pollenhealth.com>
Date: Thu, 19 Nov 2026 09:18:00 -0800
Subject: Invoice flow + VAT info for Redwood usage (Nov)

Hi Rachel,

We’re getting the monthly close sorted and need to confirm how Redwood would like to issue the Nov invoice and how our AP team should expect to receive it. Quick Qs:

- Do you prefer we get onto your portal (preferred by our AP) or continue to accept emailed PDFs? We can do either but if we onboard to the portal we need a contact for enrollment.
- Can you confirm whether Redwood will net VAT on the invoice or show VAT as a separate line? We’re in the US with an EU entity; our EU purchases should be reverse-charged where applicable.
- I’m attaching our internal PO reference (PO# PH-9421) — please advise if you also need our VAT registration/certificate for reverse-charge handling.

Thanks — if you can loop in the billing contact that will speed things up.

Samir
Samir Khanna
Finance Manager, Pollen Health
samir.khanna@pollenhealth.com
Attachment: PH-PO-9421.pdf (pdf)
From: Rachel Kim <rachel_kim@redwoodinference.com>
To: Samir Khanna <samir.khanna@pollenhealth.com>
Cc: Connor O'Brien <connor_obrien@redwoodinference.com>, Kimberly Park <kimberly_park@redwoodinference.com>
Date: Thu, 19 Nov 2026 11:03:00 -0800
Subject: Re: Invoice flow + VAT info for Redwood usage (Nov)

Hi Samir — thanks for the note and the PO. Short answers and next steps below.

1) Portal vs Email: we prefer portal-first for AP onboarding (single source of truth, automated ACKs), but we will also send an emailed PDF copy to the address you CC’d for operational continuity. If you want portal access now, Connor will send the enrollment invite.

2) VAT display: we can show VAT as a separate line item and support reverse-charge handling, but we require a valid VAT registration certificate (EU entity) before we suppress VAT on the invoice. If you provide the certificate we will issue the invoice net of VAT where applicable.

3) PO and remittance: we’ll reference PO# PH-9421 on the invoice. If you have a DocuSign PO link you prefer, include it and we’ll attach in our invoice metadata.

Next actions:
- Samir: please upload your VAT registration/certificate to the secure Drive link below or reply with the PDF.
- Connor: please send Pollen Health a portal enrollment email and set invoice copy to ap@pollenhealth.com.
- Kim: can you confirm whether we should route payments to the US bank remit or the EU entity when the reverse-charge applies?

I’m attaching a sample invoice (redwood_invoice_sample_0001.pdf) so your AP team can see the line item layout.

Cheers,
Rachel
Rachel Kim
Senior Finance Operations, Redwood Inference
rachel_kim@redwoodinference.com
Attachment: redwood_invoice_sample_0001.pdf (pdf)
Related links: https://drive.google.com/drive/fake-link/pollen-vat-evidence
From: Samir Khanna <samir.khanna@pollenhealth.com>
To: Rachel Kim <rachel_kim@redwoodinference.com>
Cc: Pollen Health AP <ap@pollenhealth.com>
Date: Fri, 20 Nov 2026 08:42:00 -0800
Subject: Re: Invoice flow + VAT info for Redwood usage (Nov)

On Thu, Nov 19, 2026 at 11:03 AM Rachel Kim <rachel_kim@redwoodinference.com> wrote:
> Hi Samir — thanks for the note and the PO. Short answers and next steps below.

Thanks Rachel — we’ll do the portal (AP prefers that). I uploaded our VAT certificate and company tax sheet to the Drive link you shared (file: pollen_vat_certificate_2026-11.pdf).

Two clarifications from AP:
- They want email copies sent to ap@pollenhealth.com for reconciliation even after portal onboarding.
- For EU-based purchases where reverse-charge applies, they want net invoices (no VAT) with the VAT certificate attached; for US-entity purchases please charge US sales tax when applicable.

If you can confirm when the first portal invoice will be issued (and which remit bank to use for net EU invoices), we’ll process PO/approval on our side.

Samir
Attachment: pollen_vat_certificate_2026-11.pdf (pdf)
From: Connor O'Brien <connor_obrien@redwoodinference.com>
To: Samir Khanna <samir.khanna@pollenhealth.com>
Cc: Rachel Kim <rachel_kim@redwoodinference.com>, Kimberly Park <kimberly_park@redwoodinference.com>
Date: Mon, 23 Nov 2026 14:05:00 -0800
Subject: Re: Invoice flow + VAT info for Redwood usage (Nov)

Samir — appreciated, and thanks for uploading the VAT certificate. Workflow confirmation and next steps below.

- Portal enrollment: I’ve sent the portal invite to your AP contact (ap@pollenhealth.com). Expect the invite TTL 72 hours; please accept and create a simple org account so our system can send invoice feeds automatically.
- Invoice issuance: We will generate the November invoice on 2026-11-30. Because you provided the VAT certificate, we will issue the EU-reverse-charge-eligible lines net of VAT and attach the certificate to the invoice record. A PDF copy will be emailed to ap@pollenhealth.com.
- Remittance: Kimberly — please confirm bank remit for net EU invoices.

Kimberly replied offline: use Redwood US bank for now; we will update remit mapping if Pollen requests EU entity remittance in future.

Open items:
1) Samir to confirm whether AP needs a specific invoice filename pattern (e.g., PH-INV-YYYYMMDD) — Connor will default to PH-INV-20261130 unless you ask otherwise.
2) If Pollen needs our invoices sent to a different billing contact in parallel, reply and we’ll add that email.

Thanks — we’ll mark this thread resolved once the portal invite is accepted.

Connor O'Brien
Billing Ops, Redwood Inference
connor_obrien@redwoodinference.com
Related links: https://app.hubspot.com/contacts/12345/DEAL-4782
